verdict.rationale: Cursor documents several ways to act on many items at once. The headless CLI can be looped over files with `agent -p --force`. Cloud Agents run in parallel without limit, and one agent can make coordinated changes across up to 20 repos. Subagents also run in parallel, and the Admin API offers bulk spend limits. Missing for 10: a native batch-operation primitive or UI (bulk work mostly comes from scripting loops or agent fleets), bulk admin endpoints beyond the preview-stage spend limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale bulk runs.
